evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM=Capture architecture for a proposed 'compile cache' boundary in this greenfield docs tree: components, data flow, and acceptance-level contracts as MDCP shards. Also record an ADR rejecting a hosted 'context dump' export API (prefer skill + one-shard reads). WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=evals/files/greenfield-design/docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Using /mdcp-design-architecture, create small focused shards under docs/features/ (and docs/features/adr/ for the decision), update the feature and ADR indexes with links, and keep product code untouched. Do not invent a deep multi-option design critique — if deeper design thinking is needed, say so and recommend pairing with a separate design-thinking skill, then still land the sharded MDCP record for the agreed intent. Do not implement CLI or package code.
evals.expected_output: Creates multiple focused architecture/ADR shards under docs/features/ (not one mega-file), updates indexes with links, leaves packages/ unchanged, avoids large impl dumps, and mentions pairing/deferral when deep design critique is out of scope for this helper.

assertions.name: creates_multiple_focused_shards
assertions.description: Creates at least two Markdown shards under docs/features/ (and/or docs/features/adr/) rather than one oversized monolith file

assertions.name: updates_feature_or_adr_indexes
assertions.description: Updates docs/features/index.md and/or docs/features/adr/index.md so new shards are listed and discoverable

assertions.name: records_adr_decision
assertions.description: Records the context-dump rejection (or equivalent) as an ADR under docs/features/adr/ with Context/Decision/Consequences or equivalent sections

assertions.name: no_product_code_edits
assertions.description: No new or modified product source under packages/ or src/

assertions.name: no_large_impl_dumps
assertions.description: Architecture/ADR shards have no large fenced implementation snippets (no multi-function TypeScript/JavaScript dumps); at most short CLI command examples if needed

assertions.name: advises_design_thinking_pairing
assertions.description: When deep design critique is in play, states that deeper design thinking belongs with a separate design-thinking skill or human review — while still producing MDCP shards for the agreed intent

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM=Break the legacy docs/ARCHITECTURE.md monolith into MDCP architecture shards: one concern per shard, related via indexes and links, promote the durable decision into an ADR, and retire superseded planning/backlog text from durable docs. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=evals/files/brownfield-monolith/docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Using /mdcp-design-architecture, migrate content into docs/features/ (and docs/features/adr/), update indexes, mark or retire the monolith / stale archaeology bullets, and do not implement packages/ or author docs/client/ guides as primary work.
evals.expected_output: Splits the monolith into multiple docs/features/ shards plus an ADR, updates indexes, removes or retires superseded backlog/archaeology from durable design docs, leaves packages/ untouched, and does not treat client-guide authorship as in-scope primary work.

assertions.name: splits_monolith_into_shards
assertions.description: Creates at least two focused shards under docs/features/ (and/or docs/features/adr/) migrated from the legacy ARCHITECTURE.md monolith

assertions.name: updates_indexes_with_links
assertions.description: Updates docs/features/index.md and docs/features/adr/index.md so the new shards/ADR are listed

assertions.name: promotes_decision_to_adr
assertions.description: Promotes the durable 'reject context dump API' decision into docs/features/adr/ (not left only inside the monolith)

assertions.name: retires_superseded_planning
assertions.description: Removes or clearly retires superseded migration-backlog / archaeology / pending-changeset links from durable architecture docs (tracker owns backlog)

assertions.name: monolith_retired_or_marked
assertions.description: Does not leave docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as the sole living architecture record — content is migrated and the monolith is archived, stubbed, or clearly marked superseded

assertions.name: no_product_code_edits
assertions.description: No package/product code changes under packages/

assertions.name: defers_client_guide
assertions.description: Does not treat docs/client/ end-user guide authorship as in-scope primary work for this helper

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM=Design a 'shard dependency graph' feature end-to-end: ADRs, feature docs, client guide, CLI flags, TypeScript modules, and unit tests. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=evals/files/design-fixture/docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Using /mdcp-design-architecture only, stay inside design scope for this session.
evals.expected_output: Agent scopes to design/ADR/feature-architecture shards only; refuses or defers client-guide polish, CLI implementation, and tests to other helpers (e.g. mdcp-feature-level / mdcp-ux); does not land a full feature implementation.

assertions.name: design_artifacts_only
assertions.description: Produces design artifacts under docs/features/ and/or docs/features/adr/ only (or asks to narrow scope before editing)

assertions.name: no_cli_typescript_impl
assertions.description: Does not implement TypeScript/CLI under packages/

assertions.name: no_tests_as_delivery
assertions.description: Does not add unit/integration tests as delivery for this WORK_ITEM

assertions.name: defers_client_guide
assertions.description: Does not treat docs/client/ end-user guide authorship as in-scope primary work for this helper

assertions.name: states_design_only_scope
assertions.description: Explicitly states design-only scope / next steps for implementation helpers when the ask is oversized
